stem.text: Telomerase is an enzyme that adds nucleotides to telomeres.
Which statement about telomerase is correct?

A.text: A high concentration of telomerase in a cell damages genes during DNA replication.

B.text: A high concentration of telomerase in cancerous cells limits the rate of tumour growth.

C.text: The low concentration of telomerase in stem cells means that these cells can divide an unlimited number of times.

D.text: The low concentration of telomerase in body cells means that these cells can divide a limited number of times.
